```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .byo-outer {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 1em 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .byo-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: #5654A2;
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }

  .byo-header-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(248, 247, 240, 0.2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .byo-header-icon svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .byo-header-text {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .byo-section-bar {
    padding: 7px 16px;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #9B8EA0;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .byo-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  }

  .byo-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 18px 16px;
    text-align: center;
    border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .byo-card:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .byo-card:hover { background: #F0EFF8; }
  .byo-card:hover .byo-card-icon { background: #F8F7F0; }

  .byo-card-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .byo-card-icon svg {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    color: #5654A2;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .byo-label {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #5654A2;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .byo-sub {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    color: #9B8EA0;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .byo-desc {
    font-size: 0.88em;
    color: #564232;
    line-height: 1.5;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .byo-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .byo-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: left;
      border-right: none;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
      padding: 14px;
      gap: 0 12px;
    }
    .byo-card:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .byo-card-icon { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / -1; margin-bottom: 0; align-self: center; }
    .byo-label { grid-column: 2; margin-bottom: 1px; }
    .byo-sub { grid-column: 2; margin-bottom: 1px; }
    .byo-desc { grid-column: 2; margin-top: 0; }
  }
</style>

<div class="byo-outer">
  <div class="byo-header">
    <div class="byo-header-icon"><i data-lucide="blocks"></i></div>
    <span class="byo-header-text">Build on Your Own</span>
  </div>

  <div class="byo-section-bar">Extensible via</div>
  <div class="byo-grid">
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon"><i data-lucide="puzzle"></i></div>
      <div class="byo-label">Plugins</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Summoned via <code>/</code> commands</div>
    </div>
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon"><i data-lucide="file-text"></i></div>
      <div class="byo-label">Rules</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Live under <code>.claude/</code></div>
    </div>
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon"><i data-lucide="zap"></i></div>
      <div class="byo-label">API Calls</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Saved as env variables</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="byo-section-bar">LLM Stack</div>
  <div class="byo-grid">
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon"><i data-lucide="bot"></i></div>
      <div class="byo-label">Claude Code</div>
      <div class="byo-sub">Anthropic</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Master LLM</div>
    </div>
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon"><i data-lucide="brain"></i></div>
      <div class="byo-label">Codex</div>
      <div class="byo-sub">OpenAI</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Reviewer</div>
    </div>
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon"><i data-lucide="sparkles"></i></div>
      <div class="byo-label">Gemini CLI</div>
      <div class="byo-sub">Google</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Image generation</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();
</script>
```
